verdict.rationale: Any product with public documentation, including an authenticator app with support pages and a GitHub project, could publish llms.txt or agent-oriented docs, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only end-user how-to support pages, OTP library code and community complaints, with no llms.txt, machine-readable docs or agent-oriented documentation.
